snapshotAndConcurrencyContract: After final prospective-R1 docs publication, bind exact final working commit/tree/source-vector/workflow-tree externally; use it once as CI-head ref target. Do not substitute stale cba4af86 or a branch-tip name for that final immutable SHA.

Base snapshot target is exactly 77993819c233737f1e2b4c11c8ca1a5d360bcbe3. Read both new ref targets back; capture full head/base commits and trees. Recompute complete compare after final docs publication; only the same three source modifications and added evidence docs may differ.

Open exactly the selected same-repository Draft PR from CI head snapshot to CI base snapshot. Record response PR id/number/node_id/url, draft/open state, creation/update times, head/base repo IDs/full_names/refs/SHAs. No PR on the working branch is part of this venue.

Freeze both CI refs and new PR metadata while selected runs are active: no head push, base push, force push, rebase, label/title/body/base edits, Ready conversion, close/reopen, rerun or dispatch. Same-new-PR synchronize would replace active runs under current cancel-in-progress=true keys. Existing different PR numbers are isolated.
Working-branch evidence commits can be pushed immediately without moving either CI snapshot; its lack of a PR is root-observed advisory context and is to remain separate from the selected new PR.

Capture synthetic merge commit/ref/tree/parents independently from head/base. For the ancestor-base proposal its merge tree should join the final head tree; verify the actual relationship and never equate merge SHA with source SHA. CI run-name already prints head/base/merge/action/draft.

Announcements, Host jobs, Packaged smoke and Stage1 jobs explicitly check out PR head; CI and Packaged scope/gate use default PR merge checkout. Bind each executed checkout to the appropriate recorded commit, not only run.head_sha.

Stage1 static-preflight additionally reads main into .current-product-lock with runtime.lock.json sparse checkout and logs its actual commit. Preserve that separate observed product commit and lock blob/content identity; it is not the PR source head.

All selected run IDs and attempts are new and assigned to this exact new PR; no original-nine or frozen-PR/run polling or mutation is permitted. Later proposed source/snapshot changes remain outside this currently unselected advisory.

captureContract.discovery: After the single new PR action, list /repos/777genius/agent-teams-ai/actions/runs with event=pull_request, branch=<CI_HEAD_REF>, head_sha=<FINAL_HEAD_SHA>, created=<new-action-window>, exclude_pull_requests=false, per_page=100, page=N. Retain every raw page and total_count; join each selected run to exact new PR number/head/base/repository and action-time window. Do not use an unfiltered repository-wide or old-head census.
captureContract.completeEnumeration: Paginate to total_count/end, deduplicate IDs, and account for all seven event-eligible workflows including Draft-skipped ones. GitHub caps filtered run searches at1000; if hit, subdivide the same new-action creation window. No first-page-only wrapper can prove completeness. If run PR metadata is absent, verify via that new run/check-suite/event proof before selecting it.
captureContract.attemptIdentity: Use /actions/runs/<NEW_RUN_ID>/attempts/<EXACT_ATTEMPT> and /actions/runs/<NEW_RUN_ID>/attempts/<EXACT_ATTEMPT>/jobs?per_page=100&page=N; capture all jobs/steps with run and attempt identities, runner labels/IDs/platform, start/end/status/conclusion. Expected initial attempt is1; no rerun selected. Never silently substitute a latest-attempt wrapper.
captureContract.terminalCapture: Observe selected new runs only until terminal, preserve all job outcomes including skips/cancellation/incomplete outcomes, and retrieve full decoded logs for selected new job IDs. Hash full retained text; step-summary wrappers are not full logs. Keep stdout/truncation/transport limitations explicit.
captureContract.artifacts: List /actions/runs/<NEW_RUN_ID>/artifacts?per_page=100&page=N through all pages. Record exact artifact ID/name/digest/size/expiry/creation times/workflow_run and its head identity; distinguish index metadata from archive content. Current generic GitHub fetch is UTF-8-only and does not download binary ZIP archives. Archive content or screenshot custody must not be claimed from index metadata alone.
